hero.title: Spiritual Guidance
hero.subtitle: A private channel for those seeking guidance according to the spiritual practice followed here.
about.title: About this practice
about.body: Stotrapriya TV shares the spiritual practice centred on Goddess Tripurasundari. This website exists as a quiet, private way for seekers to reach the Spiritual Guidance Team without needing to explain their concern in writing.
steps.title: How it works
steps.1.title: Submit your details
steps.1.body: Share your name, mobile number, place, and your chosen deities through a short private form.
steps.2.title: Received privately
steps.2.body: Your information reaches only the Spiritual Guidance Team — nothing is made public.
steps.3.title: The team reviews it
steps.3.body: Each submission is read carefully by the three members of the Guidance Team.
steps.4.title: You may be contacted
steps.4.body: If your presence is considered necessary, you will be contacted on the number you provide.
note.title: You do not need to write your question
note.body: Please provide the requested details only. Your information is submitted privately to the Spiritual Guidance Team. If the team considers that your presence is required for personal spiritual guidance, you will be contacted using the mobile number provided.
goddess.title: Goddess Tripurasundari
goddess.body: According to the spiritual practice followed here, guidance is received through the grace of Goddess Tripurasundari. Those seeking guidance are not required to describe their personal concern through this website.
offering.title: Offerings
offering.body: Any offering made after receiving personal spiritual guidance is entirely voluntary. There is no payment required to submit a request through this website.
cta.title: Ready to reach out?
cta.body: If you wish to place your details for consideration, you may submit them privately below.
form.title: Submit Your Details
form.intro: You do not need to describe your question or concern. Please provide the details below. Your information will be submitted privately to the Spiritual Guidance Team.
form.disclaimer: Please understand that submitting a request does not guarantee that you will be contacted.
form.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
success.title: Details Received
success.body1: Thank you for reaching out. Your details have been submitted privately to the Spiritual Guidance Team.
success.body2: You do not need to submit a question or describe your concern. If the team considers that your presence is required for spiritual guidance, you will be contacted using the mobile number provided.
success.body3: Please do not expect an immediate response. Not every submission requires a response.
howItWorks.title: How Spiritual Guidance Works
howItWorks.body1: According to the spiritual practice followed here, guidance is received through the grace of Goddess Tripurasundari and conveyed through the Spiritual Guide.
howItWorks.body2: Those seeking guidance are not required to describe their personal concern through this website.
howItWorks.body3: After your details are privately submitted, the Spiritual Guidance Team will review the request. When it is considered that your presence is required for personal guidance, the team will contact you and let you know when you may come to the designated place.
howItWorks.body4: Please understand that submitting a request does not guarantee that you will be contacted.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body1: This website collects only what is needed to consider your request for spiritual guidance: your full name, mobile number, place, and your chosen deities.
privacy.body2: We do not collect your email, exact address, date of birth, gender, or precise GPS location, and we do not use analytics or advertising trackers on this site.
privacy.body3: Your details are visible only to the three members of the Spiritual Guidance Team and are stored securely.
contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about this website itself (not spiritual guidance requests), please reach out through the Stotrapriya TV YouTube channel.
